run_locobot_grasping_demo: run the locobot grasping demo with configurable number of grasp attempts and sample size
create_grasper_instance: create a Grasper object to control a LoCoBot robot for grasping objects using the PyRobot API
compute_grasp_pose: compute the best predicted grasp pose from a camera image using the grasp model
reset_robot_arm: reset the robot arm to its retract position and open the gripper
perform_grasp_action: perform a complete grasp sequence at a given pose including pre-grasp, grasp, and retract
